    29|# Debugging Skill
    30|
    31|Playbooks plus the `rork-agent logs` CLI for debugging issues in your Rork app.
    32|
    33|## Which Playbook To Read
    34|
    35|- Behavior is wrong but the app builds and runs: read runtime-behavior-debugging.md before editing again. Use this for vague feedback like "it doesn't work", "still broken", "nothing happens", "button does nothing", "the tap does nothing", "not updating", "still the same", or "the screen does not change".
    36|- Runtime logs, crashes, or user-flow tracing: read runtime-logs.md.
    37|- Build, bundle, compile, archive, or App Store build failures: read build-error-debugging.md.
    38|- Backend, deployment, or Supabase failures: fetch logs with the CLI below, then apply the relevant playbook.
    39|
    40|
    41|## Fetching logs: `rork-agent logs <source>`
    42|
    43|Run in the bash tool. Output is one log per line, so pipe it to rg / head / jq to filter:
    44|
    45|```bash
    46|rork-agent logs runtime --errors | rg -i "network"   # app runtime logs, errors only
    47|rork-agent logs backend --limit 100                   # Deno hosting (Freestyle) logs
    48|rork-agent logs appstore                              # App Store build errors
    49|rork-agent logs ai-gateway --message-id <id>          # failed AI model API calls
    50|rork-agent logs supabase --since 2026-01-15T00:00:00Z # Supabase edge/postgres/auth logs
    51|```
    52|
    53|Sources:
    54|
    55|- runtime — logs from the live app (console output, crashes). Newest first; page back with `--before <id>`.
    56|- backend — Deno hosting logs from Freestyle (deployment logs, server errors).
    57|- appstore — App Store build errors and failure reasons.
    58|- ai-gateway — AI model API responses (OpenAI/Anthropic/Bedrock via the gateway); defaults to failures.
    59|- supabase — Supabase project logs (edge functions, postgres, auth, realtime). Requires a provisioned Supabase backend. Supports `--sql`, `--since`, `--until`.
    60|
    61|
    62|All sources are scoped to the current project automatically. See runtime-logs.md for the full flag reference and paging workflow.

responseMessageContents.text:
Yes — the QA audit found real production bugs in **Member Registration**:

- **False OTP delivery:** both “send code” endpoints generate a code but never call SES email or SNS SMS, while responding “sent.”
- **Insecure fallback:** OTPs are retained as plaintext in the fallback store.
- **Wrong Phase 1 requirements:** gender, ZIP/postal code, and investment roles are mandatory, although they must not be required in Phase 1.
- **Weak endpoint identity handling:** the endpoints accept a caller-supplied `userId` rather than strictly deriving it from a verified session.
- **No trustworthy live verification:** production health is up on `012bb088…`, but the owner-session broker still cannot access Supabase Admin, so canonical GitHub/CI/Render repair delivery is blocked.

I have **not patched the divergent local checkout**, because that could create an unreviewed noncanonical production change. The safe repair is ready to implement on the canonical branch once the Render Supabase admin key is live and the owner session succeeds.

**MEMBER_REGISTRATION_NOT_VERIFIED**
